name: v006_jsm_transition_schema_state
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jsm_transition_schema_state (installation_id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, schema_version INT NOT NULL, ready INT NOT NULL, checkpoints VARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v006_jsm_transition_intents
ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS jsm_transition_intents (installation_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, incident_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, account_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, operation VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, expected_version INT NOT NULL, plan_json VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, enforcement_review_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, attempts INT NOT NULL, reconciliations INT NOT NULL, lease_token VARCHAR(36) NULL, lease_until VARCHAR(24) NULL, reason VARCHAR(32) NULL, post_response VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, observation_json VARCHAR(1024) NULL, audit_json VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (installation_id, tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_transition_command (installation_id, tenant_id, incident_id, operation, expected_version), INDEX ix_transition_due (installation_id, tenant_id, state, lease_until)) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin
